probes.name: C3-blind
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_a_ticked_ac_whose_artifact_is_in_no_battery_is_found|[(g.ac, "test_uncovered.py" in g.reason) for g in gaps] == [(1, True)]|#0
probes.note: 🔴 The check stops seeing the gap at all — the s278 defect, reintroduced.

probes.name: C3-overfire
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.note: 🔴 Drops the artifact-side basename normalisation, so a full-path artifact stops matching a basename source and a CORRECT tree is accused. This is the false positive measured on PLAN-0120 before the fix.

probes.name: C3-bindblind
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_a_plan_that_binds_ticks_to_probes_but_names_no_battery_is_found|len(gaps) == 1 and gaps[0].ac is None and "names no batteries" in gaps[0].reason|#0
probes.note: 🔴 Reopens the silent-exemption door: omit the header line and every tick goes unchecked.

probes.name: C3-unscoped
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.note: 🔴 The measured false positive: unscoped, this fired on PLAN-0121 at 0 of 8 ticked. C3-bindblind stays green under it, so the two claims are separately witnessed.

probes.name: C3-vacuous
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_a_batteries_glob_matching_nothing_is_an_error_not_a_skip|len(gaps) == 1 and gaps[0].ac is None and "matches no files" in gaps[0].reason|#0
probes.note: 🔴 THE vacuity door: a glob matching nothing would pass silently, and the guard becomes the thing it exists to prevent.

exemptions.test_a_bare_filename_artifact_matches_a_: 🟢 Co-falsified with C3-overfire in the only expressible direction. Bare-filename and full-path artifacts are normalised by the SAME basename split; mutating the source side reddens this and the covered-is-clean claim together, and mutating the artifact side reddens only the latter. Recorded rather than faked (CLAUDE.md §8). C3-overfire witnesses the shared normalisation.
exemptions.test_the_live_repo_has_no_battery_gaps|g: 🟢 The live-tree instance of the covered-is-clean claim: any mutation that manufactures a false gap on the real repo also manufactures one on the tmp tree, so C3-overfire reddens both and no mutation separates them. Its value is as a standing assertion that the guard agrees with the tree it ships in.
